channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Veterans Day events are planned across Vermont for November eleventh. The centerpiece event this year in Rutland is the official unveiling of a brand-new, community-funded granite monument honoring World War Two soldiers from Rutland City and Rutland County. The monument will permanently display the names of local soldiers who were killed in action during the war.

Rutland County towns are working together to improve disaster response coordination. A recent exercise brought officials together to plan resource sharing during emergencies. The effort groups towns into subregions to enhance communication and support.

Independent grocery stores in Vermont are facing empty shelves due to a warehouse strike in New Hampshire. Deliveries have been disrupted, causing product shortages. Store owners are managing inventory amid the labor dispute.

A CCV-Rutland employee sued Vermont State Colleges alleging discrimination and harassment. Tammy Howard Davis claims retaliation and emotional distress in her lawsuit. A hearing is set for November seventeenth in Rutland County Civil Court.
